task: Correct RP5/RP6 model chemistry and refine human-reviewed alternative marking
scope: Nine original written-paper RP4–RP6 Chemistry questions in v202 supplement; changes limited to six RP5/RP6 answer rubrics, no experimental instructions.

scientificCorrections.problem: Prior rubric incorrectly described cyclohexanol and cyclohexene as the two dehydration products in a 1:1 ratio.
scientificCorrections.correctedConcept: Cyclohexanol -> cyclohexene + water, with one mole of each product per mole of cyclohexanol.

scientificCorrections.problem: Prior rubric called chromium(VI)-to-chromium(III) change oxidation.
scientificCorrections.correctedConcept: Chromium(VI) is reduced to chromium(III); orange-to-green evidence is consistent with reduction.

improvements: Add precise evidence-aligned AS Chemistry RP5/RP6 model-accepted alternatives for moles and yield, boiling-range evidence, distillation/reflux, recovery, identifying functional groups, chromium reduction, alcohol classification and limits of test specificity. Add explicit incorrect statements to prevent over-credit for wrong units, numerical claims, reversed apparatus or oxidation-state interpretations.
testPlan: Validate 9 source questions and full model marking with actual app scorer
Check 65 curated aliases each earn only their intended rubric marks
Check 17 curated wrong examples each earn zero
Check no change to question IDs, core counts and mock scope
Run four CI checks on final PR head SHA before merge
